sport.title: Dominic Thiem discloses the reason why he beat Roger Federer so regularly during his career
paras: Dominic Thiem is a famous tennis player from Austria. He retired in 2024 after winning the 2020 US Open. During the 2010s, Federer, Nadal, and Djokovic dominated the sport. Thiem challenged them often and won many important matches. His forehand and one‑hand backhand were very strong. He liked playing the Big Three because matches were exciting. He beat Federer five times, using top‑spin on the backhand. That was his clearest tactic against the great player.
sport.curious: What other tricks might Thiem have used to outplay the world's best during matches?
sport.apply: Forehand: turn your shoulders early, then swing low to high and finish over your shoulder.

sport.title: November 21, 1999: The day Lindsay Davenport defeated Martina Hingis to win the season-ending WTA Championship
paras: Every day, Tennis Majors looks back to the biggest moments in tennis history. On November 21, 1999, Martina Hingis’ era of dominance came to an end at the hands of Lindsay Davenport

On this day, November 21, 1999, Lindsay Davenport defeated Martina Hingis 6-4, 6-2 in the final of what was then called the WTA Chase Championships, the women’s season-ending event. This match was more evidence of Hingis’ struggles against an upcoming generation of very powerful players. The “Swiss Miss”, aged only 19, had already won five Grand Slam titles, but she would never manage to lift another major trophy, despite three consecutive finals reached at the Australian Open (2000-2002).

sport.title: ATP Finals Best Bets Including Carlos Alcaraz Vs Ben Shelton
paras: This eight-man tournament is down to four players. Given Jannik Sinner’s knee injury, Carlos Alcaraz and World No.

1 Alexander Zverev were always the foremost contenders for this title along with Ben Shelton, who was really strong from August through early November. Sure enough, all three of those men are in the last four, plus Daniil Medvedev, who has been very good since September and has carried his form through mid-November to get to this point. The ATP Finals did not have Novak Djokovic this year in addition to not having Sinner.
sport.apply: Fitness: finish every practice with five short sprints. Tired legs lose the last set.

sport.title: Alex de Minaur has just made a smart decision which could boost his Australian Open chances
paras: “Aussie number one in front of his home crowd. For the first time since 2019, Alex de Minaur returns to the Brisbane International,” the tournament’s official account posted on Instagram .

De Minaur has played the United Cup or the ATP Cup at the start of his last six seasons, but will return to Brisbane in 2027. The decision could prove pivotal in his bid to win a maiden Grand Slam title down under. The United Cup is a competitive tournament, but it’s not the same as standard ATP or WTA events.
sport.apply: Return: stand a step inside the baseline and split-step just as they toss.

paras: Billie Jean King and Serena Williams are two of the greatest American tennis players of all time. They won 39 Grand Slams each, across singles, doubles, and mixed doubles. King met Williams for the first time when she was just six years old, and soon learned how special she could become.
